outputs.explanation: Panel A shows micrograph-derived super-resolution reconstructions (2D projection, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows micrograph-derived super-resolution reconstructions (2D projection, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot showing the number of clusters per cell as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots overlaid for each cell, as confirmed in the caption.
Panel D is a scatter/dot plot showing cluster sizes as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots overlaid for each cluster, as confirmed in the caption.
Panel E is a scatter/dot plot showing the proportion of clustered molecules per cell as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots overlaid for each cell, as confirmed in the caption.
Panel F shows micrograph-derived reconstructions with trajectory overlays, not a plot of averaged data.

Panel G contains a histogram of diffusion coefficient distribution and a line plot of mean square displacement over time; neither displays an average with error bars requiring overlaid individual points, and both plot types (histogram/distribution and line plot) are exempt.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph (micrograph-type visualizations), not a plot of averaged data.
